newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland nears sale of department store chain.
newsitem.headline: Poland nears sale of department store chain.

text.p: The treasury ministry is likeley to complete the sale of Poland's largest department store chain Domy Towarowe Centrum SA (DTC) to a domestic consortium late in May or early in June, a deputy treasury minister said on Monday.
"Negotiations with a potential investor are on the eve of completion. We plan to sell the company at the turn of May and June," Piotr Czyzewski told reporters during a seminar on priviatisation.
Last week, a consortium grouping Bank Handlowy SA, the Empik press distributor and several Polish garment makers, clinched a deal on a social package with DTC's trade unions.
DTC has 31 department stores throughout Poland and Czyzewski said the ministry wanted to sell the whole chain to a single investor.
